messages.content:
Write a tech news digest of about 100 words based on these headlines.
Output the digest text only.

Headlines:
- Open-source agent frameworks hit production milestone as adoption triples
- Model-driven agents quietly replace hand-coded orchestration in startups
- Tool-calling reliability becomes the new benchmark for frontier models
- Multi-agent swarms move from demos to regulated enterprise workflows
- Observability standards emerge for tracing agent decisions end to end

message.content: The AI agent landscape is rapidly maturing, marked by significant shifts in both development and deployment. Open-source agent frameworks have successfully hit a major production milestone, with adoption tripling recently across the broader tech industry. In the startup ecosystem, model-driven agents are quietly replacing traditional hand-coded orchestration systems entirely. Meanwhile, tool-calling reliability has emerged as the critical new benchmark for evaluating frontier models. Multi-agent swarms are also successfully transitioning from early experimental demos to fully regulated enterprise workflows. To support this growing operational complexity, new observability standards are emerging, enabling comprehensive end-to-end tracing of autonomous agent decisions.
